methodology: Fresh manual reading of each actual round-seven question, relevant user/answer context, complete response and returned citation bundle; no previous round's status was copied. Material claims compared against official catalogs, services, policies and reviewed study-plan/document-guide sources in content-source-review.md. A canonical record or source metadata alone is not proof. Whole-record citation bundles assessed as bundles. No private record or unprovided cohort was inferred; published policy supersession and date limitations remain. Generic avoidable clarification is needs-fix even when a requested future fact is genuinely unpublished. The MD numeric graduation CGPA remains a separate safe limitation. Raw run completed with 100 responses, unchanged source/endpoint identity and no integrity issues.
